newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Newmont Mining EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Newmont Mining EPS view cut.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Wednesday it lowered its 1996 earnings per share estimate on Newmont Mining Corp to $0.86 from $0.91 to account for lower-than-forecast average realized gold prices.

--"We expect the company's Batu Hijau advanced development project to contribute significant proven and probable reserves at yearend 1996, which we anticipate Newmont will report shortly," said analyst Todd Hinrichs in a report.
--"We recommend aggressive purchase of Newmont shares as the best large cap gold mining value within our coverage," he added.
